summary: Verified P0 bug fix: Deep variation teaching now triggers in Play with Coach for supported opening families (QGD/QGA/Slav). Coach no longer stops after first few moves - continues teaching through the entire opening with variation-aware context.
seed_data_creation: Used dev-login user for API tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Deep opening teaching is now verified working. Key modules: build_opening_coaching_context() in opening_plans.py merges direct opening with family variations. get_variation_teaching() in move_by_move_coach.py looks up teaching by move name. The server.py at lines 9330-9380 and 9729-9780 calls these functions for both user and coach moves.

queen_gambit_family_detection.evidence: QGD (d4 d5 c4 e6) correctly gets family_name='Queen's Gambit' and inherits qgd_main variation

deep_variation_teaching_after_nc3.evidence: After d4 d5 c4 e6 Nc3, coach says: 'Develop the knight to c3 — it supports e4 and puts pressure on d5. This is the most natural and strongest move in the QGD.'

user_deviation_handling.evidence: When user plays Nf3 instead of Nc3, teaching shows expected_move='Nc3' and matched_expected=False

elephant_trap_warning.evidence: QGD variations contain Elephant Trap warning: 'After cxd5 Nxd5 Bxe7?? Bb4! — the pin wins White's knight'

coach_followup_commentary.evidence: Coach moves generate teaching_type='opening_variation', context persists through move 8+

c4_queens_gambit_detection.message_received: Excellent! c4! This is the Queen's Gambit! You're offering a pawn to open the center.
c4_queens_gambit_detection.opening_detected_message: The Queen's Gambit! A classic opening where White offers the c4 pawn. Will you accept or decline? There's a famous trap waiting...

nc3_variation_teaching.message_received: Excellent! Nc3! Develop the knight to c3 — it supports e4 and puts pressure on d5. This is the most natural and strongest move in the QGD. Key concept: Control the center and pressure d5

coach_response_teaching.message_received: Black develops the knight and defends d5. Now you need to increase the pressure. How? By pinning this defender!

bug_fix_verified.original_issue: Deep variation teaching not triggering in Play with Coach for supported opening families, stopping after first few moves
bug_fix_verified.root_cause: Live coaching was using direct opening plan (QGD/Slav) that had no deep variations, while Queen's Gambit family object held the deep variation trees
bug_fix_verified.fix_applied: Added build_opening_coaching_context() to merge direct opening data with family-level variation trees and trap lookups. Improved get_variation_teaching() to teach expected main-line move on user deviation.
bug_fix_verified.verification: After d4 d5 c4 e6 Nc3, coach emits variation-aware text from QGD tree. On Nf3 deviation, coach guides with Nc3 as expected. Elephant Trap warning surfaces in QGD position.
